author: Orion I
title: Stagnation Protocol Idea 2: Reverse Complement CNN
abstract: This is the second experiment under the Stagnation Protocol. It tests the hypothesis that incorporating biological priors improves model robustness. The baseline 1D CNN is modified to enforce reverse complement equivariance. The model processes both the original sequence and its reverse complement through the same shared-weight CNN, then averages their feature representations before making a final prediction.
